paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah, beginning of chapter 2, speaking in R' Abbahu’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The heading Tuvi and body Abbahu both have abbreviated titles, retained as R'. The locator says beginning of chapter2; the earlier review's Jerusalem Talmud identification remains an inference without a named-edition passage.
